messages:
sam: FYI deploybot refused to promote billing-api:v3.0.0 to staging — attestation digest mismatch between gcr and ecr mirrors.

deploybot: skipped promote for `billing-api:v3.0.0` 
reason: manifest digest differs across registries (gcr.io/redwood/billing-api -> sha256:aa11... ; registry.redwood.io/billing-api -> sha256:cc33...). preventing automatic promote to avoid provenance confusion.

lara: did the mirror job rewrite manifests again?

ryan: looks like the mirror pipeline re-compressed a layer, changing manifest digest. we've seen this with the old mirrorer that doesn't preserve digests.

megan: urgent ask: we need this in staging for canary tomorrow. can we do a safe manual flow?

ops-bot: recommended safe flow: copy canonical digest from source and promote by digest to a staging-qualified repo, then pin deploybot to the digest. avoid re-signing or retagging the unqualified v3.0.0 tag.

ryan: suggested commands (verify locally before running):
```
# get digest from canonical source
gcloud container images describe gcr.io/redwood/billing-api:v3.0.0 --format='get(image_summary.digest)'
# copy by digest preserving manifests
skopeo copy \
  docker://gcr.io/redwood/billing-api@sha256:aa11... \
  docker://registry.redwood.io/staging/billing-api:promote-1769550000 --dest-creds $REGISTRY_CREDS --preserve-digests
# verify cosign attestations
cosign verify-attestation --key kms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/cosign/cryptoKeys/cosign gcr.io/redwood/billing-api@sha256:aa11...
# set deploy pin
deploybot set-pin --service=billing-api --env=staging --image=registry.redwood.io/staging/billing-api@sha256:aa11...
```

megan: add a quick revert script in the PR: unpin + delete staging tag. rollback criteria: if error rate >3% or p95 latency increases >250ms in first 10m, revert.

sam: i'll schedule a 30m change window at 23:00 UTC; low traffic. please @mention me in the PR when ready.

lara: also open a ticket to mark mirror jobs that rewrite manifests as "rewrite-unsafe" so deploybot can treat them differently.

ryan: filing ticket now. i'll include suggested detection heuristics (compare source vs mirror manifest digest after copy).

megan: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/release/pull/1492 — includes skopeo copy, cosign verify, pin, and revert script. tagging @sam @lara @ryan

sam: thanks — i'll run the promote in the window and post outcome here. :thumbsup:
